ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-3,
Residential Single Unit (Detached House) and B3-1, Community Shopping District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-H in the area bound by:

West 68" Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Marshfield Avenue; a line
125 feet north of and parallel to West 69" Street; South Marshfield Avenue; the alley
next north of parallel to West 69" Street; and South Winchester Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Davi H\\Moore
Alderman, 17" Ward
